headline: New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd
summary: The New York Times Company is reportedly negotiating to acquire the film-focused social network Letterboxd for around $330 million, after Sony Pictures Entertainment and A24 had also been rumored as potential buyers; the Times Company declined to comment on the report.
